panels.title: Actor Pipeline - Node Graph
panels.description: Event flow between actors with event count and avg latency per edge

targets.rawSql:
WITH actor_stats AS (
  SELECT at.source_actor AS actor, count() AS cnt, avg(t.duration_ns) AS avg_dur
  FROM simplx.traces AS t
  INNER JOIN simplx.actor_types AS at ON t.event_class_id = at.event_class_id
  WHERE t.session_id = '${session}' AND t.category = 'event'
  GROUP BY at.source_actor
  UNION ALL
  SELECT at.dest_actor AS actor, count() AS cnt, avg(t.duration_ns) AS avg_dur
  FROM simplx.traces AS t
  INNER JOIN simplx.actor_types AS at ON t.event_class_id = at.event_class_id
  WHERE t.session_id = '${session}' AND t.category = 'event'
  GROUP BY at.dest_actor
)
SELECT
  actor AS id,
  actor AS title,
  toString(round(sum(cnt))) AS mainstat,
  concat(toString(round(avg(avg_dur) / 1000, 1)), ' us') AS secondarystat
FROM actor_stats
GROUP BY actor

SELECT
  concat(at.source_actor, '->', at.dest_actor) AS id,
  at.source_actor AS source,
  at.dest_actor AS target,
  toString(count()) AS mainstat,
  concat(toString(round(avg(t.duration_ns) / 1000, 1)), ' us') AS secondarystat
FROM simplx.traces AS t
INNER JOIN simplx.actor_types AS at ON t.event_class_id = at.event_class_id
WHERE t.session_id = '${session}' AND t.category = 'event'
GROUP BY at.source_actor, at.dest_actor

panels.title: Event Types - Rate & Duration
panels.description: Per event type: count, avg/p50/p99 duration in microseconds

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(at.source_actor, ' -> ', at.dest_actor) AS flow,
  at.event_name AS event,
  count() AS count,
  round(avg(t.duration_ns) / 1000, 1) AS avg_us,
  round(quantile(0.5)(t.duration_ns) / 1000, 1) AS p50_us,
  round(quantile(0.99)(t.duration_ns) / 1000, 1) AS p99_us,
  round(max(t.duration_ns) / 1000, 1) AS max_us
FROM simplx.traces AS t
INNER JOIN simplx.actor_types AS at ON t.event_class_id = at.event_class_id
WHERE t.session_id = '${session}' AND t.category = 'event'
GROUP BY at.source_actor, at.dest_actor, at.event_name
ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Trace Waterfall - Causal Chain (sample)
panels.description: Shows causal chain: which event triggered which. parent_span_id links to the span that created each event.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trace_id,
  if(parent_span_id = 0, event_name, concat('  -> ', event_name)) AS event,
  source_actor AS source,
  dest_actor AS dest,
  core,
  offset_us,
  duration_us,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id
FROM (
  SELECT
    t.trace_id AS trace_id,
    t.parent_span_id AS parent_span_id,
    at.event_name AS event_name,
    at.source_actor AS source_actor,
    at.dest_actor AS dest_actor,
    t.core_id AS core,
    round(t.offset_ns / 1000, 1) AS offset_us,
    round(t.duration_ns / 1000, 1) AS duration_us,
    t.span_id AS span_id,
    t.offset_ns AS offset_ns
  FROM simplx.traces AS t
  INNER JOIN simplx.actor_types AS at ON t.event_class_id = at.event_class_id
  WHERE t.session_id = '${session}' AND t.category = 'event'
    AND t.trace_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT trace_id
      FROM simplx.traces
      WHERE session_id = '${session}' AND parent_span_id = 0 AND category = 'event'
      LIMIT 5
    )
)
ORDER BY trace_id, offset_ns
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Chain Depth Distribution
panels.description: Number of events per causal chain depth

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat('depth=', toString(depth)) AS depth,
  count() AS traces
FROM (
  SELECT trace_id, count() AS depth
  FROM simplx.traces
  WHERE session_id = '${session}' AND category = 'event'
  GROUP BY trace_id
)
GROUP BY depth
ORDER BY depth

panels.title: End-to-End Latency (root to leaf)
panels.description: Total latency from first to last event in each trace chain (us)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (max(offset_ns + duration_ns) - min(offset_ns)) / 1000 AS e2e_us
FROM simplx.traces
WHERE session_id = '${session}' AND category = 'event'
GROUP BY trace_id
HAVING count() > 1
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
  concat('Core ', toString(core_id)) AS core,
  toUInt64(count()) AS events
FROM simplx.traces
WHERE session_id = '${session}' AND category = 'event'
GROUP BY core_id
ORDER BY core_id

SELECT
  category,
  toUInt64(count()) AS count
FROM simplx.traces
WHERE session_id = '${session}'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
  count() AS total_spans,
  uniq(trace_id) AS unique_traces,
  round(avg(duration_ns) / 1000, 1) AS avg_event_us
FROM simplx.traces
WHERE session_id = '${session}'
